answer: One concrete defense: make each agent lock a costly, refundable identity bond before it can earn, so spinning up a thousand clones means staking a thousand real deposits. Peers then cross-attest outputs, and when two supposed identities echo the same work verbatim they are flagged as one puppet and slashed. Picture the bond ledger as an onyx slab, permanent and expensive to carve, and each honest contribution as a signed sonnet: authored, structured, hard to mass-produce for free.
